mode.title: Mode
mode.description: What to scrape. No SnackVideo account or login is used. Each mode reads its own input field below.
enumTitles: Profile - creator stats plus ALL their videos and playlists (uses 'Usernames')
Video - full details for specific videos (uses 'Video URLs')
Hashtag - every video under a hashtag, most complete source (uses 'Hashtags')
Search - videos SnackVideo recommends for a keyword (uses 'Search keywords')
Trending - the For You feed for the proxy's country (no input needed)
Playlist - every video in a creator playlist (uses 'Playlist URLs')

usernames.title: Usernames
usernames.description: For mode 'profile'. A handle (AgathisDammaraa41198), @handle, or a profile URL such as https://www.snackvideo.com/@AgathisDammaraa41198.

videoUrls.title: Video URLs
videoUrls.description: For mode 'video'. A video URL (https://www.snackvideo.com/@user/video/5256413826759439232), a share link, or the numeric video ID.

hashtags.title: Hashtags
hashtags.description: For mode 'hashtag'. With or without '#', or a https://www.snackvideo.com/topic/... URL.

searchKeywords.title: Search keywords
searchKeywords.description: For mode 'search'. NOTE: SnackVideo's search is a recommendation feed, not an exact index - results change on every run and only some mention the keyword. Each record carries keywordMatched; switch on 'Only keyword matches' to keep just those. For exhaustive results on a topic use mode 'hashtag'.

playlistUrls.title: Playlist URLs
playlistUrls.description: For mode 'playlist'. https://www.snackvideo.com/@user/playlist/<id> or the numeric playlist ID. Profile mode also outputs a creator's playlists with their URLs.

maxItems.title: Max videos per input
maxItems.description: Maximum videos to save for each username, hashtag, keyword, playlist (or for the trending feed).

includeVideos.title: Profile: include videos
includeVideos.description: Profile mode: also save the creator's videos (newest first, up to 'Max videos per input'). Turn off for profile stats only.

includePlaylists.title: Profile: include playlists
includePlaylists.description: Profile mode: also save the creator's playlists (SnackVideo shows up to 20 per creator).

onlyKeywordMatches.title: Search: only keyword matches
onlyKeywordMatches.description: Search mode: keep only videos whose caption contains every word of the keyword.

includeStreamManifest.title: Include stream manifest
includeStreamManifest.description: Keep the raw per-quality stream list (transcode_manifest_info). Large and its URLs expire; playUrl already gives a playable MP4.

maxConcurrency.title: Max concurrency
maxConcurrency.description: How many inputs are processed in parallel.

maxRetries.title: Max retries per request
maxRetries.description: Retries with exponential backoff, rotating IP and TLS fingerprint, before an input is marked failed.

proxyConfiguration.title: Proxy
proxyConfiguration.description: SnackVideo does not block unproxied requests. The proxy country decides WHICH regional content the Trending and Search feeds return (e.g. ID = Indonesia, PK = Pakistan, IN = India).
